entries.proposition: The data are a secondary transcriptomic analysis of liver RNA-seq generated in an earlier toxicology study, not a new dosing experiment.
entries.snippet: These RNA-seq data were originally used only for SMN1 transgene expression analysis

entries.proposition: The vector was an AAV9-PHP.B capsid carrying CBh-SMN1, given intravenously, in cynomolgus monkeys and rats.
Group size in the monkey dataset was two per sex per dose, one male fewer at the mid dose.
entries.snippet: The cynomolgus dataset included 2 males and 2 females per dose, except for the male mid-dose group, which included only one animal.

entries.proposition: Fold changes and p values treat the four liver lobes of one animal as biological replicates.
entries.snippet: Fold changes and p values were calculated considering the 4 lobes from each animal as biological replicates.

entries.proposition: Unfolded-protein-response activation was found only at doses of 5e13 vg/kg and above, while DNA-damage/p53 and innate signatures were also present at the low dose and in rats.
entries.snippet: UPR activation was observed only in animals receiving doses

entries.proposition: The DNA-damage/p53 signature was already present at the lowest dose.
entries.snippet: Livers from low-dose-treated NHPs also exhibited activation of the DNA damage response and the p53 signaling pathway.

entries.proposition: Transgene expression level correlated positively with the pro-apoptotic PERK effector DDIT3 and negatively with CES1.
entries.snippet: SMN1 expression levels and vector dose (vg/animal) positively correlated with the pro-apoptotic PERK effector DDIT3 (CHOP)

entries.proposition: The earlier study reported only mild immune-cell infiltration at the acute time point, from which the authors infer a vector-specific T-cell response is unlikely.
entries.snippet: histological analysis revealed only mild immune cell infiltration, suggesting that a vector-specific, T cell-mediated response is unlikely

entries.proposition: The ATF6 and IRE1-XBP1 branches were not seen, and the data for that statement are not shown.
entries.snippet: However, no activation of the ATF6 pathway or of the IRE1α-XBP1 pathway was detected (data not shown).

entries.proposition: The authors give the rat result an expression-level explanation: about tenfold lower transgene expression in rat liver.
entries.snippet: The absence of UPR activation in rats receiving high vector doses can be explained by the approximately 10-fold lower levels of transgene expression

entries.proposition: The authors say the dataset is mechanistic and not a temporal model of the clinical scenario.
entries.snippet: these data should be interpreted as mechanistic insights rather than a direct temporal model of the clinical scenario

entries.proposition: The authors state the contribution of each pathway is not resolved.
entries.snippet: Additional mechanistic studies are needed to identify the role of each pathway and the exact factors involved in their activation.

entries.proposition: The authors cite empty-capsid and promoterless-vector monkey data from another group as support that genome plus transgene expression are needed; it is not tested in this paper.
entries.snippet: no liver damage occurred in animals receiving empty capsids
